evaluation.contact_scope: Every 2 ms solve, independently replayed from public native state with executed targets; exact float32 endpoint state and named-sensor equality required
evaluation.tactile_scope: Simulated per-geometry occupancy counts and peak contact-force norms, not hardware tactile pressure; fixture wrench includes inertial and gravity loads
evaluation.force_units: contact/fixture force N, fixture torque N m; actuator force fraction is dimensionless
evaluation.gate: Blade-first, no pre-hit ground or any ball/body/handle/wicket contact, vx > 1 immediately after first separation, full 2 s stability/guard/joint/actuator checks
